run_info_action_by_job_id: run info_action to look up a Sheep by job ID and display its folder and log path
run_info_action_by_argv: run info_action to look up a Sheep by command-line argv signature and display its details
retrieve_xp_metrics: retrieve the latest metrics history for a Sheep's XP using main.get_xp_history
cancel_sheep_job: cancel a running Sheep job using shepherd.cancel_lazy and shepherd.commit
tail_sheep_log: tail the last 200 lines of a Sheep's log file in follow mode using os.execvp
